tracks.title: พี่เลี้ยงบ้านเฮา
tracks.genre: Isan lam ruang story-lam dance song (group-lam band, fast storytelling groove)
tracks.subject: Noi, a Roi Et nanny in a Bangkok townhouse, has taught three-year-old Ton to say 'saep nua' at the dinner table, and at his school recital he says it into the microphone while his mother turns pale
